how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Keonjhar Assistant Cook Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://kendujhar.odisha.gov.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OAV Keonjhar Assistant Cook recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the OAV Keonjhar Assistant Cook recruitment is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Assistant Cook post in Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Keonjhar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Cook position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Cook position will receive a salary of Rs. 6750 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to the Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying to the Assistant Cook post is between 21 years and 32 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for this recruitment for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Cook role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Cook role primarily involves Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: The specific educational qualification details are not provided in the summary. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for this information.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Keonjhar: https://kendujhar.odisha.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates as mentioned in the official notification.
